Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْأَوَّلِ بِلَا أَوَّلٍ كَانَ قَبْلَهُ
Translation: All praise belongs to Allah, the First without any beginning before Him

Arabic text: وَ الْآخِرِ بِلَا آخِرٍ يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ
Translation: And the Last without any end after Him

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ قَصُرَتْ عَنْ رُؤْيَتِهِ أَبْصَارُ النَّاظِرِينَ
Translation: The One whose vision is beyond the sight of those who observe

Arabic text: وَ عَجَزَتْ عَنْ نَعْتِهِ أَوْهَامُ الْوَاصِفِينَ
Translation: And whose description is beyond the imagination of those who describe
He originated creation with His power, a complete origination
And fashioned them according to His will, a perfect fashioning
Then He set them on the path of His intention
And sent them on the way of His love

Arabic text: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ تَأْخِيرًا عَمَّا قَدَّمَهُمْ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: They cannot delay what He has hastened for them

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَقَدُّمًا إِلَى مَا أَخَّرَهُمْ عَنْهُ
Translation: Nor can they hasten what He has delayed for them
And He has assigned for every soul among them
A known, allocated sustenance from His provision
No decrease can diminish what He increases

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَزِيدُ مَنْ نَقَصَ مِنْهُمْ زَائِدٌ
Translation: And no increase can add to what He decreases

Arabic text: ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُ فِيْ الْحَيَاةِ أَجَلًا مَوْقُوتًا
Translation: Then He set for each a fixed term in life
And established for each a limited duration
Approaching it through the days of their lives
And reaching it through the years of their time
Until when one reaches the end of their journey
And completes the count of their lifetime
He takes them to what He has ordained for them

Arabic text: مِنْ مَوْفُورِ ثَوَابِهِ، أَوْ مَحْذُورِ عِقَابِهِ
Translation: Either to abundant reward or dreaded punishment
That He may recompense those who do evil according to what they did
And reward those who do good with goodness
With justice from Him, holy are His names
And manifest are His blessings

Arabic text: لَا يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَ هُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
Translation: He is not questioned about what He does, but they are questioned

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَوْ حَبَسَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَعْرِفَةَ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah who, if He had withheld from His servants

Arabic text: حَمْدِهِ عَلَى مَا أَبْلَاهُمْ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ الْمُتَتَابِعَةِ
Translation: The knowledge of praising Him for the continuous favors He bestowed upon them

Arabic text: وَ أَسْبَغَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ نِعَمِهِ الْمُتَظَاهِرَةِ
Translation: And the abundant blessings He showered upon them
They would have used His blessings without praising Him

Arabic text: وَ تَوَسَّعُوْا فِيْ رِزْقِهِ فَلَمْ يَشْكُرُوهُ
Translation: And expanded in His provision without thanking Him

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ كَانُوْا كَذَلِكَ لَخَرَجُوْا مِنْ حُدُودِ الْإِنْسَانِيَّةِ
Translation: And had they been like that, they would have departed from the bounds of humanity
To the limits of animality

Arabic text: فَكَانُوْا كَمَا وَصَفَ فِيْ مُحْكَمِ كِتَابِهِ
Translation: And they would have been as He described in His clear Book

Arabic text: إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبيلًا
Translation: "They are like cattle, nay, they are even more astray from the path"

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah for what He has made known to us of Himself
And inspired us of His gratitude

Arabic text: وَ فَتَحَ لَنَا مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِهِ
Translation: And opened for us the doors of knowledge of His Lordship

Arabic text: وَ دَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْإِخْلَاصِ لَهُ فِيْ تَوْحِيدِهِ
Translation: And guided us to sincerity to Him in His Oneness

Arabic text: وَ جَنَّبَنَا مِنَ الْإِلْحَادِ وَ الشَّكِّ فِيْ أَمْرِهِ
Translation: And kept us away from heresy and doubt in His command

Arabic text: حَمْدًا نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
Translation: Praise by which we live among those who praise Him from His creation

Arabic text: وَ نَسْبِقُ بِهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إِلَى رِضَاهُ وَ عَفْوِهِ
Translation: And by which we outpace those who hasten to His pleasure and forgiveness

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يُضِيْءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ
Translation: Praise that illuminates for us the darkness of the grave

Arabic text: وَ يُسَهِّلُ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ سَبِيلَ الْمَبْعَثِ
Translation: And eases for us the path of resurrection

Arabic text: وَ يُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الْأَشْهَادِ
Translation: And honors our stations at the stands of the witnesses

Arabic text: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
Translation: On the Day when every soul will be rewarded for what it earned, and they will not be wronged

Arabic text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَ لَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
Translation: On the Day when no friend will avail a friend in anything, nor will they be helped

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إِلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ
Translation: Praise that rises from us to the highest of 'Illiyyin (lofty places)
In a written record, witnessed by those brought near

Arabic text: حَمْدًا تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إِذَا بَرِقَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ
Translation: Praise by which our eyes are comforted when sight is dazzled

Arabic text: وَ تَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إِذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الْأَبْشَارُ
Translation: And by which our faces are brightened when complexions are darkened

Arabic text: حَمْدًا نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نَارِ اللَّهِ
Translation: Praise by which we are freed from the painful Fire of Allah
To the generous neighborhood of Allah
Praise by which we join His close angels
And accompany His sent prophets

Arabic text: فِيْ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِيْ لَا تَزُولُ
Translation: In the abode of permanence that does not cease

Arabic text: وَ مَحَلِّ كَرَامَتِهِ الَّتِيْ لَا تَحُولُ
Translation: And the place of His honor that does not change

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah who chose for us the best of creation
And provided us with wholesome sustenance

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلَ لَنَا الْفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ الْخَلْقِ
Translation: And granted us excellence with authority over all creation
So all His creatures are submissive to us by His power
And compliant to our obedience by His might

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَاجَةِ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah who closed the door of need for us except to Him

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّيْ شُكْرَهُ لَا، مَتَى
Translation: So how can we adequately praise Him, or when can we fulfill His thanks? No, when?

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلَاتِ الْبَسْطِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah who installed in us the means of expansion
And made for us the instruments of contraction
And blessed us with the spirits of life
And established in us the limbs for deeds
And nourished us with wholesome sustenance
And enriched us by His grace
And satisfied us by His favor
Then He commanded us to test our obedience
And prohibited us to test our gratitude
But we deviated from the path of His command
And pursued what He forbade
Yet He did not hasten to punish us
And did not rush His vengeance upon us
Rather, He treated us with patience out of His generosity
And awaited our return with His kindness and forbearance

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ دَلَّنَا عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah who guided us to repentance

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إِلَّا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
Translation: Which we could not have achieved except through His grace
If we were to count nothing of His grace

Arabic text: إِلَّا بِهَا لَقَدْ حَسُنَ بَلَاؤُهُ عِنْدَنَا
Translation: Except this, His favor would still be beautiful to us
And His kindness to us magnificent
And His bounty upon us immense

Arabic text: فَمَا هَكَذَا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِيْ التَّوْبَةِ
Translation: For His way regarding repentance was not like this
For those who came before us
He has indeed relieved us
Of what we had no strength to bear
And has not charged us except with our capacity
And has not burdened us except with ease

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَدَعْ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَ لَا عُذْرًا
Translation: And has left no one among us with an excuse or pretext
So the perished among us is the one who perishes against Him

Arabic text: وَ السَّعِيدُ مِنَّا مَنْ رَغِبَ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And the happy among us is the one who seeks Him

Arabic text: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
Translation: And all praise belongs to Allah with all the praise
That the nearest of His angels have praised Him with
And the most honorable of His creation to Him
And the most pleasing of those who praise Him
Praise that exceeds all other praise
As our Lord exceeds all His creation
Then to Him belongs praise
For every blessing He has upon us

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَ الْبَاقِينَ
Translation: And upon all His servants, past and present

Arabic text: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْأَشْيَاءِ
Translation: To the number of all things encompassed by His knowledge

Arabic text: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا
Translation: And in place of each one of them, its number

Arabic text: أَضْعَافًا مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَدًا سَرْمَدًا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: Multiplied endlessly and eternally until the Day of Resurrection
Praise that has no end to its limit
And no reckoning of its number
And no reaching its goal
And no cessation to its duration

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إِلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَ عَفْوِهِ
Translation: Praise that becomes a connection to His obedience and forgiveness
And a cause for His pleasure
And a means to His pardon
And a path to His Paradise
And a protection from His vengeance
And a security from His wrath
And a support for His obedience
And a barrier against His disobedience

Arabic text: وَ عَوْنًا عَلَى تَأْدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظَائِفِهِ
Translation: And an aid in fulfilling His rights and duties

Arabic text: حَمْدًا نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِيْ السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِهِ
Translation: Praise by which we become happy among the fortunate of His friends

Arabic text: وَ نَصِيرُ بِهِ فِيْ نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَاءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
Translation: And join the ranks of martyrs by the swords of His enemies
Indeed, He is the Praiseworthy Guardian
